"Fast" '''Vanush Thriin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] vendor in the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Vanush had five models of speeder on sale, the [[Protector (hoverbike)|Rendili Protector]], [[Watchman (hoverbike)|Rendili Watchman]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Patroller]], Czerka [[Cruiser (hoverbike)|Cruiser]] and the [[Striker (hoverbike)|Ubrikkian Striker]]. He offered each vehicle for 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and had each vehicle on display for potential customers. As a Bith, he had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and whilst working he wore green and brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vanush first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Vanush's role in the game is that of a mount vendor for players of the Republic faction, as Anchorhead is a Republic area. Vanush was also mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', which provided his last name.
